udiff_turnover_meaning: NOTIONAL TURNOVER in Rupees: (Strike + Premium) * Contracts * LotQty
stt_taxable_base: Traded Premium on sale side (regular trading) OR Intrinsic Value (Settlement Price - Strike) on exercise of in-the-money options at expiry
official_source: NSE Circular NSE/FAOP/64101; Finance Act (No.2) 2024 Chapter VII
notes: Contract lot sizes vary by underlying security (e.g. 1550 for ABCAPITAL). European style settlement.

udiff_turnover_meaning: NOTIONAL TURNOVER in Rupees: (Strike + Premium) * Contracts * LotQty
stt_taxable_base: Traded Premium on sale side (regular trading). Cash settled on expiry.
official_source: NSE Circular NSE/FAOP/64101; Finance Act (No.2) 2024 Chapter VII
column15: NIFTY NEXT 50. All options are European exercise (CE/PE).

udiff_turnover_meaning: FULL CONTRACT TURNOVER in Rupees: Futures Price * Contracts * LotQty (equal to TtlTrfVal)
exact_premium_formula: Not Applicable (Futures have no premium; TtlTrfVal is the full turnover)
stt_taxable_base: Sale side traded turnover (TtlTrfVal * 0.5 under symmetric buy/sell reporting)
official_source: NSE F&O Master Circular; Section 98 Finance (No.2) Act 2004
notes: Subject to physical delivery settlement for open positions at expiration since October 2019.
